newsitem.title: USA: Omnicom Group promotes two to replace Jones.
newsitem.headline: Omnicom Group promotes two to replace Jones.

text.p: Omnicom Group Inc said on Monday it will promote Thomas Harrison to president of U.S. operations for its Diversified Agency Services unit, while Michael Birkin will become as president of international operations.
Both duties currently are performed by Peter Jones, who is retiring. John Wren continues as chairman and chief executive.

Harrison, 49, currently is president of Diversified's Healthcare Communications Group, a job he will keep in addition to his new duties. Birkin, 38, currently is Diversified's managing director in Europe.
